title: HantaWatch Real time hantavirus outbreak tracker
summary: HantaWatch is a real-time web-based tracker that monitors and displays hantavirus outbreak data globally, providing public access to disease surveillance information.
problem_solved: Provides accessible real-time tracking and visualization of hantavirus outbreaks for public awareness and health monitoring.
why_valuable: Enables early detection and awareness of hantavirus spread, helping communities and health officials respond more effectively to potential outbreaks.
